interpretation_rule.TEXT_RUT_MUCH_WEAKER_THAN_URL: Standalone RUT text representation is materially weaker.
interpretation_rule.TEXT_ADDS_LITTLE_GIVEN_URL: Text contributes little incremental linear information beyond URL.
interpretation_rule.TEXT_HEAVILY_TRUNCATED: 256-token input likely discards a large fraction of available text.
interpretation_rule.RAW_TEXT_STRONG_BUT_RUT_TEXT_WEAK: Likely representation/truncation bottleneck rather than absence of textual signal.
interpretation_rule.HTML_STRUCT_CONTAINS_SUBSTANTIAL_ADDITIO: Current visible-text stream discards useful HTML-structural evidence.

limitations: The audit is diagnostic and post-hoc; it is not a new confirmatory hypothesis test.
The FINAL audit subset is a fixed model-independent subset rather than the entire FINAL set.
Raw TF-IDF probes diagnose information availability and are not directly comparable as model families to the Transformer probes.
html_struct is evaluated as a raw token sequence only; no new structure-aware neural model is trained.
Auxiliary heads of the TRI model are intentionally not used for the core modality comparison because they have different training objectives/weights.
